trap.label: tell + to
trap.right: I told her to call me.
trap.why: Em português “disse a ela que ligasse”. Em inglês, tell/advise/invite + pessoa + to + verbo base; a negativa é not to.

fix.wrong: He warned that I not touch it.
fix.right: He warned me not to touch it.
They invited me to have dinner.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “Call me,” I said to her.
rewrite.answer: I told her to call me.

rewrite.answer: She warned us not to panic.
